verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents M2M applications that issue API access credentials for programmatic, non-human access (workos-docs-32). It also has an OAuth authorization server for MCP/agent access (workos-docs-8, workos-docs-27) and custom roles and permissions (workos-docs-3, workos-docs-40), which together point toward distinct machine identities rather than shared human credentials. However, the evidence never shows per-agent narrowly scoped permissions for M2M clients or instant revocation. WorkOS's own MCP server lets agents act with the same dashboard access as the connecting human (workos-docs-9), which is the opposite of least privilege for that case. Missing for 10: documented per-agent scoped permissions on M2M credentials, instant credential/token revocation, agent-specific identity guidance, independent corroboration.
